message.content:
This appears to be a CBP ruling on a steel turnover rack for aluminum profiles. The likely classification is 9403.20 (other metal furniture) or 8466.30 (work-holding accessories for machine tools), or 7326.90 (other articles of iron or steel). I recall a ruling that classified a "steel turnover rack" in 7326.90.8688 (other articles of iron or steel, other, other). An alternative is 8609 (containers), but that is not suitable. A rack used to transport profiles in a workshop is not a container for transport by multiple modes. Heading 7326 covers "other articles of iron or steel," and since the rack is made of steel members that are welded or assembled, forged or stamped is not applicable. The subheading would be 7326.90.8688, the other category with a 2.9% duty rate.
